definitions: A resinous substance dissolved in a liquid for applying on wood, metal, or other materials to form a hard, clear, shiny surface when dry.
An outward appearance that is intended to conceal something unpleasant or undesirable.
examples: The antique table needed a new coat of varnish.
He tried to put a varnish of respectability on his shady dealings.
The artist applied a protective varnish to the painting.
